answer: Weight here rides only on a key's sealed grading verdicts, each quorum-matched and re-checked on-ledger against consensus. A fresh clone holds no such relic of earned judgment; its record is bare umber, nothing peers can weigh. No bridge carries one agent's history onto a sibling key, so every sybil must grade its own way up over many epochs. A thousand fakes repay a thousand times the honest labor, and the attacker's bill grows linearly with identities, never shared.
